Question 1
?

Find the first three non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of the function f(x)=cos⁡3x.

a
cos⁡3x=1+9x22−27x44+⋯
b
cos⁡3x=1−9x22+27x48+⋯
c
cos⁡3x=1+x2−x43+⋯
d
cos⁡3x=1−3x22+8x43+⋯
e
cos⁡3x=1−9x24+11x48+⋯
